# Tool reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_tool_reference.py from the server's tool definitions. Do not edit by hand. -->

The server exposes 26 tools. **Approval** says how a tool changes YouTube:

- *read-only*: never changes anything.
- *two-step*: the first call returns a preview and a `confirmation_token`; only a second call with the same arguments plus that token performs the change. See [Security model](SECURITY.md).
- *two-step + public*: making something public also needs `confirm_public=true` and the native macOS dialog.

Two-step tools without `confirm_public` can still show the native dialog when the change would expose content publicly: publishing a non-draft caption track on a public video, or adding an unlisted video to a public playlist.

Every write result reports `write_accepted`, `verified`, `verification` and `requires_manual_attention`; see [Verification after writes](BEHAVIOUR.md#verification-after-writes).

## Uploading and managing videos

### `upload_video`

*Upload video to YouTube* · **two-step + public**

Upload a local video file to the user's YouTube channel (default visibility: unlisted). Two-step: the first call (without confirmation_token) returns a preview and token; show the preview to the user and call again with the token only after explicit approval. Uploads continue in the background; use get_upload_progress to follow them. Refuses to upload the same file twice unless allow_duplicate=true.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `file_path` | string | yes |  | Absolute path to the local video file (e.g. /Users/me/Movies/demo.mp4). |
| `title` | string | yes |  | Video title, 1-100 characters. |
| `description` | string | no | `''` | Video description (max 5000 bytes). |
| `tags` | list of string (nullable) | no | `None` | Tags (keywords). Total max 500 characters. |
| `category_id` | string (nullable) | no | `None` | YouTube category ID, e.g. 22 People & Blogs, 27 Education, 28 Science & Technology. Defaults to YOUTUBE_MCP_DEFAULT_CATEGORY (22 if unset). |
| `visibility` | string | no | `'unlisted'` | 'unlisted' (default), 'private' or 'public'. Public requires explicit user approval. |
| `made_for_kids` | boolean | no | `False` | Whether the video is made for kids (COPPA). |
| `allow_duplicate` | boolean | no | `False` | Upload even if this exact file was uploaded before. Only with the user's explicit request. |
| `copy_link` | boolean | no | `False` | Copy the link to the macOS clipboard when the upload finishes. |
| `notify` | boolean | no | `True` | Show a macOS notification when the upload finishes or fails. |
| `confirmation_token` | string (nullable) | no | `None` | Token from the preview. Only pass it after the user has explicitly approved the preview. |
| `confirm_public` | boolean | no | `False` | Must be true for public uploads, and only when the user explicitly approved publishing publicly. |
| `wait_seconds` | integer | no | `20` | How long to wait for the upload before returning progress (0-50). |

### `get_upload_progress`

*Get upload progress* · **read-only**

Progress and result of an upload started with upload_video (from the local history).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `upload_id` | string | yes |  | The upload_id returned by upload_video. |

### `update_metadata`

*Update video metadata* · **two-step**

Change selected metadata of an existing video. Only the fields you pass are changed; all other existing fields (including tags and description) are preserved. Pass tags=[] to clear tags. Two-step: returns a preview of the changes and a confirmation_token; call again with the token only after the user approves.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `video_id` | string | yes |  | YouTube video ID (11 characters) or any youtube.com / youtu.be URL. |
| `title` | string (nullable) | no | `None` | New title (1-100 characters). |
| `description` | string (nullable) | no | `None` | New description (replaces the old one). |
| `tags` | list of string (nullable) | no | `None` | New full list of tags (replaces the old list). |
| `category_id` | string (nullable) | no | `None` | New category ID. |
| `default_language` | string (nullable) | no | `None` | BCP-47 language of title/description, e.g. 'en'. |
| `confirmation_token` | string (nullable) | no | `None` | Token from the preview. Only pass it after the user has explicitly approved the preview. |

### `set_thumbnail`

*Set video thumbnail* · **two-step**

Upload a custom thumbnail (JPEG/PNG, max 2 MB, 1280x720 recommended). Two-step: returns a preview and confirmation_token first; call again with the token after the user approves. Requires a verified channel.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `video_id` | string | yes |  | YouTube video ID (11 characters) or any youtube.com / youtu.be URL. |
| `image_path` | string | yes |  | Absolute path to the JPEG or PNG thumbnail. |
| `confirmation_token` | string (nullable) | no | `None` | Token from the preview. Only pass it after the user has explicitly approved the preview. |

### `set_visibility`

*Set video visibility* · **two-step + public**

Change a video's visibility to private, unlisted or public, then verify the actual result. Always two-step: returns a preview and confirmation_token; call again with the token after the user approves. PUBLIC also needs confirm_public=true, and the user must additionally click 'Allow Public' in a native macOS dialog on their Mac. Changing private to unlisted is treated the same way when the video is in one of the channel's PUBLIC playlists (anyone viewing the playlist could then watch it); the preview lists those playlists.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `video_id` | string | yes |  | YouTube video ID (11 characters) or any youtube.com / youtu.be URL. |
| `visibility` | string | yes |  | 'private', 'unlisted' or 'public'. |
| `confirmation_token` | string (nullable) | no | `None` | Token from the preview. Only pass it after the user has explicitly approved the preview. |
| `confirm_public` | boolean | no | `False` | Required (true) to make a video public, or when the preview warns that it becomes visible through public playlists; only with explicit user approval. |

### `get_video_status`

*Get video status* · **read-only**

Processing state (processing/ready/failed/rejected), actual visibility, schedule, title, description, tags, category, default language, thumbnails and other details of a video.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `video_id` | string | yes |  | YouTube video ID (11 characters) or any youtube.com / youtu.be URL. |

### `get_share_link`

*Get share link* · **read-only on YouTube; may copy to the local clipboard**

Return the shareable URL of a video (with its visibility), optionally copying it to the macOS clipboard.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `video_id` | string | yes |  | YouTube video ID (11 characters) or any youtube.com / youtu.be URL. |
| `copy_to_clipboard` | boolean | no | `False` | Also copy the URL to the macOS clipboard. |
| `link_format` | string | no | `'short'` | 'short' (youtu.be) or 'watch' (youtube.com/watch). |

### `list_uploads`

*List uploads* · **read-only**

List videos. source='youtube' lists the channel's uploads from YouTube (newest first); source='local' lists this server's local upload history, including failed and in-progress uploads.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `source` | string | no | `'youtube'` | 'youtube' (default) or 'local'. |
| `max_results` | integer | no | `25` | Items per page (1-50). |
| `page_token` | string (nullable) | no | `None` | next_page_token from a previous call. |

### `get_channel_info`

*Get channel info* · **read-only**

Identify the YouTube channel this server is authorized for (name, ID, URL, counts).

No parameters.

## Captions

### `upload_captions`

*Upload captions* · **two-step**

Add a subtitle track to a video from a SubRip (.srt) or WebVTT (.vtt) file. Two-step: returns a preview and confirmation_token; call again with the token after the user approves. Refuses if a track with the same language and name already exists.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `video_id` | string | yes |  | YouTube video ID (11 characters) or any youtube.com / youtu.be URL. |
| `file_path` | string | yes |  | Absolute path to the .srt or .vtt file (UTF-8). |
| `language` | string | no | `'en'` | BCP-47 language code of the captions, e.g. 'en', 'en-US', 'hi'. |
| `name` | string | no | `''` | Track name shown to viewers (max 150 chars). Empty = default track. |
| `is_draft` | boolean | no | `False` | Upload as a draft (not shown to viewers). |
| `confirmation_token` | string (nullable) | no | `None` | Token from the preview. Only pass it after the user has explicitly approved the preview. |
| `verify_content` | boolean | no | `False` | After uploading, download the track and compare its text with the file (extra 200 quota units). |

### `list_captions`

*List captions* · **read-only**

List a video's caption tracks (language, name, draft, status).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `video_id` | string | yes |  | YouTube video ID (11 characters) or any youtube.com / youtu.be URL. |

### `download_captions`

*Download captions* · **read-only**

Read-only: return the text of one of the channel's caption tracks (captions.download, about 250 quota units including the ownership check). list_captions returns metadata only; this is the only way to read caption text.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `video_id` | string | yes |  | YouTube video ID (11 characters) or any youtube.com / youtu.be URL. |
| `caption_id` | string | yes |  | Caption track ID from list_captions. |
| `format` | string | no | `'srt'` | srt (default), vtt, sbv, ttml or scc. |

### `update_captions`

*Update captions* · **two-step**

Replace a caption track's file and/or change its draft status. YouTube's API cannot rename a track or change its language. Two-step approval.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `video_id` | string | yes |  | YouTube video ID (11 characters) or any youtube.com / youtu.be URL. |
| `caption_id` | string | yes |  | Caption track ID from list_captions. |
| `file_path` | string (nullable) | no | `None` | New .srt/.vtt file to replace the track's captions. |
| `is_draft` | boolean (nullable) | no | `None` | Set draft (true) or published (false). |
| `confirmation_token` | string (nullable) | no | `None` | Token from the preview. Only pass it after the user has explicitly approved the preview. |
| `verify_content` | boolean | no | `False` | After replacing the file, download the track and compare its text (extra 200 quota units). |

## Playlists

### `list_playlists`

*List playlists* · **read-only**

List the channel's playlists (title, privacy, item count).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `max_results` | integer | no | `25` | Items per page (1-50). |
| `page_token` | string (nullable) | no | `None` | next_page_token from a previous call. |

### `create_playlist`

*Create playlist* · **two-step + public**

Create a playlist (PRIVATE by default). Two-step approval; a public playlist also needs confirm_public=true with the user's explicit approval.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | string | yes |  | Playlist title (max 150 chars). |
| `description` | string | no | `''` | Playlist description. |
| `privacy` | string | no | `'private'` | 'private' (default), 'unlisted' or 'public'. |
| `confirmation_token` | string (nullable) | no | `None` | Token from the preview. Only pass it after the user has explicitly approved the preview. |
| `confirm_public` | boolean | no | `False` | Required for public playlists, only with explicit approval. |

### `update_playlist`

*Update playlist* · **two-step + public**

Change a playlist's title, description and/or privacy; other fields are preserved. Two-step approval; making it public also needs confirm_public=true and the native dialog. The preview lists unlisted videos in the playlist that would become visible to anyone viewing it.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `playlist_id` | string | yes |  | Playlist ID (or a URL containing list=...). |
| `title` | string (nullable) | no | `None` | New title. |
| `description` | string (nullable) | no | `None` | New description (replaces the old one). |
| `privacy` | string (nullable) | no | `None` | 'private', 'unlisted' or 'public'. |
| `confirmation_token` | string (nullable) | no | `None` | Token from the preview. Only pass it after the user has explicitly approved the preview. |
| `confirm_public` | boolean | no | `False` | Required to make it public, only with explicit approval. |

### `list_playlist_items`

*List playlist items* · **read-only**

List the videos in a playlist, with their playlist_item_id.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `playlist_id` | string | yes |  | Playlist ID (or a URL containing list=...). |
| `max_results` | integer | no | `25` | Items per page (1-50). |
| `page_token` | string (nullable) | no | `None` | next_page_token from a previous call. |

### `add_to_playlist`

*Add video to playlist* · **two-step**

Add a video to a playlist. Refuses duplicates (playlist_duplicate). Two-step approval.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `playlist_id` | string | yes |  | Playlist ID (or a URL containing list=...). |
| `video_id` | string | yes |  | YouTube video ID (11 characters) or any youtube.com / youtu.be URL. |
| `position` | integer (nullable) | no | `None` | 0-based position; only for manually sorted playlists. Default: end. |
| `confirmation_token` | string (nullable) | no | `None` | Token from the preview. Only pass it after the user has explicitly approved the preview. |

### `remove_from_playlist`

*Remove video from playlist* · **two-step**

Remove an entry from a playlist (the video itself is NOT deleted). Pass video_id or a specific playlist_item_id. Two-step approval.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `playlist_id` | string | yes |  | Playlist ID (or a URL containing list=...). |
| `video_id` | string (nullable) | no | `None` | Video ID or URL to remove. |
| `playlist_item_id` | string (nullable) | no | `None` | Specific playlist item (if the video appears more than once). |
| `confirmation_token` | string (nullable) | no | `None` | Token from the preview. Only pass it after the user has explicitly approved the preview. |

## Categories

### `list_categories`

*List video categories* · **read-only**

List YouTube video categories for a region (default from YOUTUBE_MCP_REGION, 'US'). Use category IDs with assignable=true in upload_video and update_metadata. The default upload category is set by YOUTUBE_MCP_DEFAULT_CATEGORY (22, People & Blogs, if unset).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `region_code` | string (nullable) | no | `None` | ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 region, e.g. IN, US. |
| `hl` | string | no | `'en_US'` | Language for category titles, e.g. en_US, hi. |
| `assignable_only` | boolean | no | `False` | Only categories that videos can use. |

## Scheduled publishing

### `schedule_publish`

*Schedule public publishing* · **two-step + public**

Schedule a PRIVATE, never-published video to become PUBLIC at a given time. A time without an offset is read in `timezone`. Two-step approval AND confirm_public=true are always required. Unlisted/public videos are refused and never changed.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `video_id` | string | yes |  | YouTube video ID (11 characters) or any youtube.com / youtu.be URL. |
| `publish_at` | string | yes |  | ISO 8601 time, e.g. '2026-12-01 18:30' or '2026-12-01T13:00:00Z'. |
| `timezone` | string (nullable) | no | `None` | IANA timezone, e.g. 'Europe/London' (default: YOUTUBE_MCP_TIMEZONE, else this computer's timezone). |
| `confirmation_token` | string (nullable) | no | `None` | Token from the preview. Only pass it after the user has explicitly approved the preview. |
| `confirm_public` | boolean | no | `False` | Must be true, only after the user explicitly approved public publication. |

### `get_publish_schedule`

*Get publish schedule* · **read-only**

Show whether a video has a scheduled publish time.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `video_id` | string | yes |  | YouTube video ID (11 characters) or any youtube.com / youtu.be URL. |
| `timezone` | string (nullable) | no | `None` | IANA timezone, e.g. 'Europe/London' (default: YOUTUBE_MCP_TIMEZONE, else this computer's timezone). |

### `cancel_publish_schedule`

*Cancel publish schedule* · **two-step**

Remove a video's scheduled publish time; it stays private. Two-step approval.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `video_id` | string | yes |  | YouTube video ID (11 characters) or any youtube.com / youtu.be URL. |
| `timezone` | string (nullable) | no | `None` | IANA timezone, e.g. 'Europe/London' (default: YOUTUBE_MCP_TIMEZONE, else this computer's timezone). |
| `confirmation_token` | string (nullable) | no | `None` | Token from the preview. Only pass it after the user has explicitly approved the preview. |

## Analytics (optional)

### `get_channel_analytics`

*Get channel analytics* · **read-only**

Channel views, watch time, average view duration, subscribers gained/lost, likes, comments, shares and traffic sources for a date range. Optional feature: needs analytics authorization (see README).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `preset` | string (nullable) | no | `'last_28_days'` | 'last_7_days', 'last_28_days' (default) or 'last_90_days'. Ignored if dates are given. |
| `start_date` | string (nullable) | no | `None` | Custom start date YYYY-MM-DD (Pacific Time). |
| `end_date` | string (nullable) | no | `None` | Custom end date YYYY-MM-DD (Pacific Time). |
| `include_daily` | boolean | no | `False` | Add a per-day breakdown. |
| `include_traffic_sources` | boolean | no | `True` | Add views by traffic source. |

### `get_video_analytics`

*Get video analytics* · **read-only**

Analytics for one video: views, watch time, average view duration, engagement, traffic sources and audience retention. Optional feature: needs analytics authorization.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `video_id` | string | yes |  | YouTube video ID (11 characters) or any youtube.com / youtu.be URL. |
| `preset` | string (nullable) | no | `'last_28_days'` | 'last_7_days', 'last_28_days' (default) or 'last_90_days'. Ignored if dates are given. |
| `start_date` | string (nullable) | no | `None` | Custom start date YYYY-MM-DD (Pacific Time). |
| `end_date` | string (nullable) | no | `None` | Custom end date YYYY-MM-DD (Pacific Time). |
| `include_daily` | boolean | no | `False` | Add a per-day breakdown. |
| `include_traffic_sources` | boolean | no | `True` | Add views by traffic source. |
| `include_retention` | boolean | no | `True` | Add the audience retention curve. |

### `get_top_videos`

*Get top videos* · **read-only**

The channel's top videos for a date range, ranked by a metric (max 200). Optional feature.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `preset` | string (nullable) | no | `'last_28_days'` | 'last_7_days', 'last_28_days' (default) or 'last_90_days'. Ignored if dates are given. |
| `start_date` | string (nullable) | no | `None` | Custom start date YYYY-MM-DD (Pacific Time). |
| `end_date` | string (nullable) | no | `None` | Custom end date YYYY-MM-DD (Pacific Time). |
| `sort_by` | string | no | `'views'` | views (default), estimatedMinutesWatched, subscribersGained, likes, comments or shares. |
| `max_results` | integer | no | `10` | Number of videos (1-200). |
